description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as a founding engineer, building systems that help organizations understand how AI agents crawl, retrieve, and cite information on the web. You will design experiments and production systems that improve how businesses are surfaced by AI assistants.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and run experiments to understand how AI agents crawl, retrieve, and cite web content.

 - Build and ship production software using modern fullstack technologies.

 - Develop or debug telemetry and routing pipelines that support the product.

 - Explore how large language models select, assess, and trust information.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least one year of experience as a fullstack engineer building production systems.

 - Experience building fullstack AI applications and shipping product engineering work.

 - Production experience with Next.js, TypeScript, or Go.

 - Experience with LLM infrastructure or evaluation, or with edge systems and platforms.

 - Experience building or debugging telemetry and routing pipelines.

 - Curiosity about AI agents and comfort working in an experimental, early-stage environment.

 - Existing US work authorization; sponsorship is not available.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $100,000 to $150,000 annually. Equity: 0.10% to 0.30%. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
